d:
Indaur ki stim sabudana khichri: nahin chipakti, chatapta masala
Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani: indaur ki mashhur stimd sabudana khichri + khas chatapta masala
sabudana kaise bhigoen ki khichri chipke nahin
bina tale, stim men paki halki aur khili khichri
indauri chatapta masala: dahi bhalle, pohe aur chips par bhi
Navratri ki shubhkamnayein! Aapne Indore ki steamed sabudana khichdi kabhi khayi hai? Vrat wali ya chatpati, aap kaise khana pasand karenge? Comment mein zaroor batayein
